author: antoinettea768

title: Guadalupe and the historic sites of Centro in Sevilla
text: Fantastic tour guide Guadalupe was very knowledgeable and personable. I enjoyed her anecdotes very much. She showed us lots of interesting parts of the sites we visited. Guadalupe checked on all the people in her group and kept track of us. The Real Alcazar was super beautiful and so interesting to see the Roman, Moorish and Spanish elements. Lovely gardens. The cathedral was quite amazing and impressive. I did not go up the Giralda but the others said it was interesting as well. Excellent tour, well worth the cost.
author: laurahR3754EE

title: Fabulous tour with Phillipo
text: This way such an informative and interesting tour. The Royal Alcazar is absolutely beautiful. I just loved every part of it. Beware of the tower - it is very nice, but it is 34 ramps to get up, but it does have great views of the city. The cathedral is also amazingly beautiful. Throughout this entire tour Philippe provided so much information and in a very humorous and entertaining way. Highly recommend
